stories.headline: TECH LEADERS *DEMAND* HUANG'S RETURN
stories.facts: Elon Musk and tech executives signed a petition with over 115,000 signatures demanding Nvidia reinstate Jensen Huang.
stories.caption_line: 📝 Elon Musk and tech leaders are petitioning Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang.
stories.image_prompt: Photorealistic cinematic portrait. In the foreground, Jensen Huang stands confident in his iconic black leather jacket with arms crossed, rim-lit by warm orange and electric blue stage lighting. Behind him, glowing holographic petition counters and rising digital signatures scroll upwards in neon orange. In the midground, modern Silicon Valley glass headquarters and bustling conference stages blur into a deep blue evening sky. Holographic graphs and glowing network nodes hover throughout the frame.
stories.source_title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang

stories.headline: OPENAI *DISSOLVES* DEDICATED ROBOTICS TEAM
stories.facts: OpenAI reassigned its dedicated robotics researchers, citing general-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra that can already operate robots directly.
stories.caption_line: 🤖 OpenAI is reassigning its dedicated robotics unit because general models can now control robots directly.
stories.image_prompt: Photorealistic cinematic composition. In the foreground, an intricate metallic robotic hand reaches forward, bathed in vivid electric-blue neon. In the midground, high-tech server racks in a clean robotics laboratory glow under soft amber overhead lights. Floating above, holographic neural network schematics, floating orange data streams, and glowing diagnostic UI panels project into the air. Clean futuristic tech lab atmosphere with strong contrast between cool blue metal and warm glowing nodes.
stories.source_title: OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary

stories.headline: MEITUAN *DEBUTS* MASSIVE AGENT MODEL
stories.facts: Meituan released LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter AI agent model trained entirely on Chinese hardware, showcasing a sample deployment on 194 Huawei Ascend chips without Nvidia GPUs.
stories.caption_line: 🇨🇳 Meituan launched a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model trained on Chinese hardware, with sample deployment on 194 Huawei chips.
stories.image_prompt: Photorealistic tech composition. In the foreground, a glowing custom AI silicon processor sits prominently on a circuit board, bathed in electric-blue rim light. In the midground, towering server racks hum in an ultra-modern Asian supercomputing facility. Transparent holographic terminal benchmarks showing rising glowing orange scores and floating network data cubes surround the chip. Dramatic low-angle perspective, atmospheric neon haze in warm orange and cyan.
stories.source_title: Meituan releases a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model that never touched an Nvidia GPU

stories.headline: GEMINI *DETHRONES* OPENAI IN MATH
stories.facts: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon captured the top MathArena benchmark score from GPT-6.1 Sol, though running it costs 15 times more.
stories.caption_line: 📐 Google's Gemini 4 Carbon took the MathArena benchmark crown from OpenAI despite costing 15 times more.
stories.image_prompt: Photorealistic editorial composition. In the foreground, a sleek glowing crystal prism refracts intense electric-blue light beams across an illuminated metallic desk. In the midground, a dark research laboratory features holographic glowing mathematical equations, floating orange geometric diagrams, and a glowing digital benchmark leaderboard. Moody studio lighting, high contrast with vibrant warm-orange data vectors cutting through deep navy shadows.
stories.source_title: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol

stories.headline: ANTHROPIC *CONFRONTS* HUGE COMPUTE RISKS
stories.facts: Dario Amodei revealed Anthropic faces nearly $901 billion in compute commitments, calling the costs a major dilemma before its IPO.
stories.caption_line: ⚠️ Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei warned that $901 billion in compute commitments pose deep business uncertainty before its IPO.
stories.image_prompt: Photorealistic editorial portrait. In the foreground, Dario Amodei stands with a serious, confident expression, hands resting quietly, illuminated by warm-orange studio rim light. Behind him in the midground, an endless corridor of massive data center server cabinets glows with electric-blue LED indicators. Floating holographic financial charts, glowing compute usage graphs in orange, and translucent prospectus data hover dynamically in the air. High-tech, cinematic corporate atmosphere.
stories.source_title: Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO

stories.headline: CENTRAL BANK *SEES* YOUTH DISPLACEMENT
stories.facts: Australia's central bank found employment among workers aged 15 to 24 dropped sharply in AI-exposed roles like software and customer support.
stories.caption_line: 📉 Australia's central bank reported early signs that AI is cutting entry-level jobs for workers under 25.
stories.image_prompt: Photorealistic conceptual tech scene. In the foreground, a modern glass computer monitor displays translucent glowing orange charts showing falling job metrics. In the midground, an empty corporate open-plan office desk with headphones and a laptop sits under dramatic dusk skyline light pouring through floor-to-ceiling windows. Floating electric-blue digital network connections and translucent data streams drift across the room. Subtle, moody ambiance with warm sunset orange and deep teal tones.
stories.source_title: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service

stories.headline: ANTHROPIC *UPGRADES* DEFAULT CLAUDE MODEL
stories.facts: Anthropic made Claude Opus 5.5 the default for paid users and advised customers to drop complex prompting habits like "think hard."
stories.caption_line: ⚡ Anthropic set Claude Opus 5.5 as the default for paid plans while urging users to simplify their prompts.
stories.image_prompt: Photorealistic digital interface scene. In the foreground, an elegant laptop rests on a minimalist wooden desk, its screen casting an electric-blue glow displaying a sleek chatbot interface. In the midground, a contemporary tech office at twilight is visible through large windows. Floating holographic text prompt bubbles, glowing orange parameter sliders, and luminous neural network threads hover above the keyboard. Cinematic studio lighting with warm-orange accents against deep indigo shadows.
stories.source_title: Anthropic says outdated prompting habits are slowing down Claude Opus 5.5

cover_subline: Musk petitions for Huang, OpenAI dissolves robotics, and Gemini tops math.
cover_image_prompt: Epic photorealistic tech collage. In the foreground, Jensen Huang stands in his iconic black leather jacket with arms crossed under dramatic warm-orange rim lighting. To the left, a gleaming robotic hand reaches outward glowing in electric-blue neon. To the right, glowing AI silicon processors and towering server racks fill the midground. Floating holographic math charts, glowing orange petition metrics, and digital data streams weave throughout the high-tech scene. Electric-blue and warm-orange palette, no readable text.
caption:
Tech leaders rally for Jensen Huang, OpenAI alters its robotics strategy, and more top developments:

1. 📝 Elon Musk and tech leaders are petitioning Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang.
2. 🤖 OpenAI is reassigning its dedicated robotics unit because general models can now control robots directly.
3. 🇨🇳 Meituan launched a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model trained on Chinese hardware, with sample deployment on 194 Huawei chips.
4. 📐 Google's Gemini 4 Carbon took the MathArena benchmark crown from OpenAI despite costing 15 times more.
5. ⚠️ Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei warned that $901 billion in compute commitments pose deep business uncertainty before its IPO.
6. 📉 Australia's central bank reported early signs that AI is cutting entry-level jobs for workers under 25.
7. ⚡ Anthropic set Claude Opus 5.5 as the default for paid plans while urging users to simplify their prompts.
